item.title: Scholar: Boys kissing, ‘genderfluid pottery artists’ in kids’ lit make ‘better masculinity role models’
item.description: An Edinburgh Napier Univ. scholar highlights how boys kissing and diverse characters in children's literature can reshape masculinity. Adrianna Zabrzewska argues that addressing toxic masculinity through narratives fosters emotional expression and connection. Recommended books like "Two Boys Kissing" emphasize vulnerability and relationality, promoting better role models and challenging dominant gender norms.

item.title: What will happen to higher education in 2026? Our top predictions
item.description: OPINION/ANALYSIS The College Fix’s Gabrielle Temaat counts down The College Fix’s top predictions for 2026. From free speech battles and antisemitism to AI trends and academic reform, this upcoming year is poised to bring about even more change to the higher education landscape.

item.title: More than half of UC Berkeley disability accommodations are ’emotional’
item.description: At UC Berkeley, over half of registered disabled students have psychological or emotional disabilities. The number of students seeking accommodations has surged, raising concerns about potential system abuse.
